Name: Season UI Icons
Author: IllogicalMoodSwing
Description:
I've updated the season and weather icons shown on the on-screen clock, and I think they're a little clearer and a little cuter than vanilla!

Spring, summer and winter have a couple of options and can be changed in the config file. The icon for fall and the weather icons (sunny, petals, leaves, snow, festival and anniversary) have only been slightly tweaked.

Happy to take requests for icons you think best represent each season and type of weather. The symbol representing a season shouldn't be used for weather (eg summer can't be represented by a sun, because it's already used for sunny weather), so I'd love to hear suggestions!

[b]Install[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
